newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares seen extending light downtrend.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares seen extending light downtrend.

text.p: Polish shares were expected to extend moderate losses in light activity on Friday on the back of Thursday's selling in continuous trade and amid concerns over Poland's mid-term macroeconomic outlook.

Analysts said concerns over Poland's widening trade gap and possible interest rate rises, weaker zloty, and the burden of flood-relief efforts on the state's finances added to the general uncertainty ahead of the September 21 polls.

Traders expected the market to test the psychological support of 15,000 points on the main WIG index but were split whether the index, which closed on Thursday at 15,102.9, would fall significantly below that level on Friday.
Some said the market appeared oversold and several prices seemed attractive enough to stir up some bargain-hunting.
